name: Burrow
rules: No points. +1 income, and one free dig at once (lost if not used this turn).
notes: The plain building, now the early one (reactive-play.md 11.2): three a family under the lodge, all on the inner ring. Clay comes free from any shore hex; you pay the tolls. Was 2 VP until playtest-v2.

name: Logging camp
rules: Forest only, as the first building there. A wood source that never runs out: the first three loads from it cost 1 each, then 2, 3, 4..., paid to you; yours are free until the fourth.
notes: Stage 2 (brainstorm-stage-2-3.md 6.3); three a family from playtest-v2 (reactive-play.md 10).

name: Quarry
rules: Hills with stone only, as the first building there. A stone source: the first three loads cost 1 each, then 2, 3, 4..., paid to you; yours are free until the fourth.
notes: Stone is the late resource: dearer to haul (stoneBankToll). One quarry on the lodge's inner ring from playtest-v2.

name: Wharf
rules: Needs 2+ canals on its borders. When built, 1 money per canal on its borders.
notes: Rewards busy junctions. Never VP per canal: digging must not raise the Dig lane's own multiplicand (scoring.md).

name: Holt
rules: 4 VP, and +1 VP at game end per building next to it, anyone's, up to +4. Needs stone and wood.
notes: A late building (reactive-play.md 11.4): two loads, no surcharge, 4 points. Three a family from playtest-v2.

name: Mill
rules: 4 VP, and +1 more income (+2 in all). Needs two wood.
notes: A late building: two loads, no surcharge, 4 points (reactive-play.md 11.4).

name: Lock
rules: 4 VP. Needs 3+ canals on its borders, wood and stone. Every haul through a canal on its borders, yours included, pays you 1, from the bank.
notes: The toll house: rewards owning a junction. Still rarely built (reactive-play.md 11.3): worth a look.
